title: For artists
introduction: Share your music. Tell us what you want to make next.
notice: Every introduction is reviewed by Artan Records. Profiles are published only after approval. Sending work does not create an account or an offer of representation.

form.subject: Artan Records artist enquiry
form.privacy: This form sends your details and links through FormSubmit to Artan Records. FormSubmit states that it retains submissions for 30 days. Share listening links, not private masters or sensitive documents.
form.acknowledgement: I understand that my enquiry will be processed by FormSubmit and emailed to Artan Records.

channels.title: Artist introduction
channels.description: Your artist name, a short biography, and links to your music and portfolio.

channels.title: Send your work
channels.description: Send listening links and a few words about the project, its credits, and its release plans. No masters or project files are needed at this stage.

channels.title: Collaborate
channels.description: A recording, a visual project, or an idea to develop together. Tell us your role and what you have in mind.
